Synopsis:
    BoE Governor Bailey attributes rising government debt and elevated bond yields across advanced economies to structural forces — weak productivity, demographic aging, defence spending demands, and pandemic shocks. UK 10-year gilt yields recently hit near 20-year highs. Bailey references the Iran war as a key uncertainty for the MPC's inflation outlook. Markets are pricing ~10% chance of a BoE hike in September, rising to >60% for November. The article is UK/European-centric with no direct commentary on US monetary policy.
